'''September 2000 San Jose tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Comics and Fantasies, San Jose, CA on 9 September 2000. [[Alfred Dong]] won it. It is known from Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1228">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-14-san-jose-ca-9-9-the-real-mccoyd1228/ san-jose-ca-9-9-the-real-mccoy], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 14 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-14-san-jose-ca-9-9-the-real-mccoyd1228/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Comics and Fantasies, San Jose, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alfred Dong]]
